Post 1
📉 ASX 200 slipped 20.90pts (-0.23%) to 9,188.50 Thursday — but the real story is CWY surging 15.19% while the index drifts. Breadth is fractured. Five-day loss sits at 0.90%. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
Utilities led all sectors +2.78% while Telcos shed 2.30%. Materials fell 0.71%, Financials barely moved +0.08%. A defensive rotation signal hiding inside a flat tape. #ASX #utilities #ausbiz

Post 3
🔺 ASX Limited jumped 9.03% to AUD 60.52 — one of the sharpest single-session moves the exchange operator has seen. When the market's own infrastructure stocks run hot, the market notices. #ASX #ausbiz #financials

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,218.35/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7041. Silver AUD 92.37/oz. Metals priced firmly in local terms — a weaker AUD amplifying the safe-haven bid for Australian holders. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits just 1.16% below its 52-week high. The question is whether Utilities leadership and gold strength signal defensiveness — or a genuine breakout setup. Where do you see the index in five sessions? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
